headline: 共折りたたみAIは、Mac1に結合する薬の形を半数以上当てる
subhead: 未公開のMac1–リガンド結晶構造551個で、AF3・Boltz-2・Chai-1を評価した
target_label: SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 マクロドメイン（Mac1）

summary.question: 共折りたたみ法の評価は、訓練データとの独立性が確かめにくく、テスト用の構造数も足りなかった。
summary.approach: 訓練の締め切り日より後にX線で決めた551個のMac1–リガンド構造を使い、3つの共折りたたみ法とDOCK3.7を比べた。
summary.result: 3つの共折りたたみ法はいずれも半数超のリガンドを2 Å未満の誤差で再現した。ペプチドの反転や大きなループの開きは再現できなかった。
summary.learned: 共折りたたみは既知リガンドの配置と序列付けに強い。ドッキングの候補選別では、ドッキングより優れるとは言えなかった。

question.quote: While deep-learning co-folding methods can help address these challenges, their evaluation has been hampered by the difficulties in assessing independence from training data and insufficiently large test sets.

approach.quote: Here, we test the ability of co-folding methods to predict the structures of 551 ligands, 489 of which are of sufficient quality for evaluation, bound to the SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 macrodomain (Mac1) that were determined after the training cutoff dates.

result.quote: AlphaFold3 (AF3), Boltz-2, and Chai-1 each reproduced >50% of the Mac1 ligand poses to better than 2 Å root-mean-square deviation of experiment.
we did not find that common conformational rearrangements, including peptide flip and a large loop opening, were recapitulated by the co-folding prediction.

learned.quote: Conversely, when the more homogeneous benchmark of true ligands was replaced by a diverse set of docked molecules, composed of what would turn out to be hundreds of true ligands and thousands of false positives, the co-folding methods did no better than docking and often did worse.

open.quote: Even though the prospective docking hit lists included thousands of diverse molecules, they still represent only three targets, and so offer a limited view of molecular recognition.

highlights.text: 論文は、約1 Åの分解能でX線構造を決めたMac1–リガンド複合体のうち、未公開だった551個を評価用に用意した。AF3とChai-1は約70%、Boltz-2は53%、DOCK3.7は40%のリガンドを2 Å未満の誤差で再現した。

evidence.quote: From our internal dataset, we identified 551 ligands where we determined X-ray structures that have not been disclosed previously (Figure 1a, Supplementary file 1).
Using the field standard, 2 Å cutoff for correct predictions, AF3 and Chai-1 predicted roughly 70% of the ligands correctly.

highlights.text: 実験で見られたペプチド主鎖の反転（twisted）の19例のうちAF3が当てたのは4例、約8 Åのループの開き（open）の20例では0例だった。それでもリガンドの位置は低いRMSDで当たっており、AIは詳細な物理ではなく結合の型を学んでいるらしい。

evidence.quote: We observed that only 4/19 twisted states and 0/20 open states were correctly predicted by AF3.
This result suggests that co-folding reliably recapitulates dominant ligand-binding interactions even in the absence of accurate protein conformational modeling

highlights.text: AmpC、σ2受容体、ドーパミンD4受容体の大規模ドッキングで実験的に調べた候補のうち、偽陽性から真のリガンドを選ぶ力は、AF3ではドッキングに及ばなかった。Boltz-2の親和性予測はドッキングと同程度だった。ただし候補はもともとドッキングで選ばれており、著者はこれがドッキングに有利に働いたと述べている。

evidence.quote: AF3 ligand pose confidence values did not separate true ligands from high-scoring false positives as effectively as docking scores or Boltz-2 affinity predictions did.
An important caveat is that the hit lists were composed of molecules prioritized by docking in the first place, giving it an advantage on these particular sets.

lab_notes.sample_prep: P43結晶形のMac1結晶にリガンドを2.5〜20 mMでソーキング。
lab_notes.data_collection: PanDDAのevent mapにリガンドをCootで構築し、phenix.refineで精密化。

evidence.quote: Ligands were soaked into SARS-CoV-2 Mac1 crystals at nominal conentrations ranging from 2.5-20 mM using the P43 crystal form Schuller et al., 2021.
We modeled ligands into PanDDA event maps (Pearce et al., 2017) using ligand coordinates and restraints generated with phenix.elbow (Moriarty et al., 2009).

editor_notes: 新しい構造は、Mac1とリガンド551個のX線構造（約1 Å）。本文に挙がる新規PDBはAVI-5083(15JC)・AVI-3363(15CH)・AVI-4129(15DE)・AVI-4225(15DX)で、いずれも未公開。551個の全IDは補足ファイルにあり、本文では確認できない。Mac1の初構造ではない（既存の構造が多数ある）。
